style.fo-wm-k0: padding: 0px; min-width: 0px; width: 6px; height: 14px; border-radius: 3px 3px 1px 1px; background-color: #e8b931; flex: none;
style.fo-wm-k1: padding: 0px; min-width: 0px; width: 6px; height: 20px; border-radius: 3px 3px 1px 1px; background-color: #e8b931; flex: none;
style.fo-wm-k2: padding: 0px; min-width: 0px; width: 6px; height: 14px; border-radius: 3px 3px 1px 1px; background-color: #e8b931; flex: none;
style.fo-wm-ic: padding: 0px; width: auto; gap: 3px; align-items: flex-end; flex: none; padding-block-end: 3px;
style.fo-wm-a: display: block; margin: 0px; font-family: "Archivo"; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.3rem; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: #f3f6f9; @media(--mobile) { font-size: 1.08rem; letter-spacing: 0.01em; }
style.fo-wm-b: display: block; margin: 0px; font-family: "Figtree"; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.62rem; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.2em; color: #b9c6d4; @media(--mobile) { font-size: 0.56rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; }
style.fo-wm-nm: padding: 0px; width: auto; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.3rem;
style.fo-wm: padding: 0px; min-width: 0px; display: flex; width: auto; flex: none; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; text-decoration: none; &:focus { outline-width: 3px; outline-color: #e8b931; outline-style: solid; outline-offset: 3px; }
style.fo-d: display: block; margin: 0px; font-family: "Figtree"; font-size: 0.93rem; line-height: 1.55; color: #b9c6d4; max-width: 40ch;
style.fo-ig: display: block; margin: 0px; font-family: "Figtree"; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.95rem; color: #f3f6f9; text-decoration: none; &:hover { color: #e8b931; } &:focus { outline-width: 3px; outline-color: #e8b931; outline-style: solid; outline-offset: 3px; }
style.fo-q: display: block; margin: 0px; font-family: "Figtree"; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.95rem; color: #f3f6f9; text-decoration: none; &:hover { color: #e8b931; } &:focus { outline-width: 3px; outline-color: #e8b931; outline-style: solid; outline-offset: 3px; }
style.fo-w: display: block; margin: 0px; font-family: "Figtree"; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.95rem; color: #f3f6f9; text-decoration: none; &:hover { color: #e8b931; } &:focus { outline-width: 3px; outline-color: #e8b931; outline-style: solid; outline-offset: 3px; }
style.fo-g: padding: 0px; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,2fr) minmax(0,1fr); grid-template-rows: auto; gap: 2.5rem; @media(--mobile) { grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr); grid-template-rows: auto auto; gap: 1.75rem; }
style.fo-cp: display: block; margin: 0px; font-family: "Figtree"; line-height: 1.55; color: #b9c6d4; font-size: 0.82rem;
style.fo-ax: display: block; margin: 0px; font-family: "Figtree"; line-height: 1.55; color: #b9c6d4; font-size: 0.82rem;
style.fo-fine: padding: 0px; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.5rem; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-block-start: 2.5rem; padding-block-start: 1.5rem; border-width: 1px 0px 0px 0px; border-style: solid; border-color: rgba(243,246,249,0.14);
style.fo-w2: padding: 0px; width: 100%; max-width: 1200px; margin-inline-start: auto; margin-inline-end: auto; padding-inline-start: 40px; padding-inline-end: 40px; flex-direction: column; @media(--mobile) { padding-inline-start: 16px; padding-inline-end: 16px; }
style.fo: padding: 0px; width: 100%; background-color: #0f1c2e; padding-block-start: 4rem; padding-block-end: 3rem; flex-direction: column; @media(--tablet) { padding-block-end: 7rem; }
style.mb-q: font-family: "Figtree"; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; text-decoration: none; text-align: center; padding-block-start: 0.9rem; padding-block-end: 0.9rem; padding-inline-start: 1.6rem; padding-inline-end: 1.6rem; border-radius: 12px; border-width: 2px; border-style: solid; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; transition: background-color 0.2s, color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; color: #0f1c2e; background-color: #e8b931; border-color: #e8b931; flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 52px; font-size: 1rem; box-shadow: 0px 0px 0px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0); &:focus { outline-width: 3px; outline-color: #e8b931; outline-style: solid; outline-offset: 3px; } &:hover { background-color: #f3c94e; border-color: #f3c94e; color: #0f1c2e; }
style.mb: display: none; position: fixed; width: auto; inset-inline-start: 0px; inset-inline-end: 84px; inset-block-end: 0px; z-index: 100000000; flex-direction: row; padding: 8px; background-color: rgba(15,28,46,0.95); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); border-width: 1px 1px 0px 0px; border-style: solid; border-color: rgba(243,246,249,0.14); border-radius: 0px 14px 0px 0px; @media(--tablet) { display: flex; }
